entries.sanskrit:
द्वितीये तु कलेर् दोष-वृद्धौ कल्क्य्-अवतारतः ।

अधर्मिष्ठे जने नष्टे पुनः कृत-युगागमः ॥

कलि-धर्मान् प्रपञ्चयति—ततश् चेत्य्-आदिना ॥१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ततश् चानुदिनं धर्मः सत्यं शौचं क्षमा दया ।
कालेन बलिना राजन् नङ्क्षत्य् आयुर् बलं स्मृतिः ॥
word_for_word: when the irreligious people are destroyed
the arrival of the Kṛta age
he elaborates the characteristics of Kali
entries.literal_english: In the Second Canto, when the faults of Kali have increased, the arrival of Kalki is meant; when the irreligious people have been destroyed, the Kṛta age returns. He elaborates the characteristics of Kali beginning with the words ‘thereafter’.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
tataś cānudinaṃ dharmaḥ satyaṃ śaucaṃ kṣamā dayā |
kālena balinā rājan naṅkṣaty āyur balaṃ smṛtiḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: धर्म-न्याययोर् व्यवस्थायां बलम् एव ॥२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
वित्तम् एव कलौ नॄणां जन्माचार-गुणोदयः ।
धर्म-न्याय-व्यवस्थायां कारणं बलम् एव हि ॥
word_for_word: in the arrangement of religious duty and justice
entries.literal_english: In the ordering of religious duty and legal justice, strength alone is the determining factor.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
vittam eva kalau nṝṇāṃ janmācāra-guṇodayaḥ |
dharma-nyāya-vyavasthāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ balam eva hi ||

entries.sanskrit: दाम्पत्ये भार्या-पति-भावेऽभिरुचिर् एव हेतुर् न कुल-गोत्रादिः । व्यावहारिके क्रय-विक्रयादौ । स्त्रीत्वे पुंस्त्वे च तयोः श्रैष्ठ्ये रति-कौशलम् एव हेतुर् न कुलम् आचारो वा ॥३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
दाम्पत्येऽभिरुचिर् हेतुर् मायैव व्यावहारिके ।
स्त्रीत्वे पुंस्त्वे च हि रतिर् विप्रत्वे सूत्रम् एव हि ॥
word_for_word: not family, lineage, and so on
entries.literal_english: In marriage, mutual attraction alone is the cause, not family, gotra, or the like. In practical dealings such as buying and selling, the relevant standard is merely worldly expedience. In a woman’s or man’s excellence, skill in sexual enjoyment alone is regarded as the cause, not family or good conduct.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
dāmpatye’bhirucir hetur māyaiva vyāvahārike |
strītve puṃstve ca hi ratir vipratve sūtram eva hi ||

entries.sanskrit: आश्रमाणां ख्यातौ ज्ञाने लिङ्गम् एव दण्डाजिनादिकं हेतुर् न त्व् आचार-विशेषः । अन्योन्यापत्ति-कारणं चाश्रमाद् आश्रमान्तर-प्राप्तौ च कारणम् । यद् वा,  बहूदक-हंसादीनाम् अन्योन्यापत्तौ नमस्कारादि-व्यवहारे कारणम् । अवृत्त्या मुद्रार्पणादि-दानासामर्थ्येन न्याये दौर्बल्यं पराजयः । चापलं वचो बहु-भाषणम् ॥४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
लिङ्गम् एवाश्रम-ख्याताव् अन्योन्यापत्ति-कारणम् ।
अवृत्त्या न्याय-दौर्बल्यं पाण्डित्ये चापलं वचः ॥
word_for_word: the external sign alone is the cause
the cause of one another’s status
through inability to offer money and gifts
entries.literal_english: For identifying the āśramas, external signs such as a staff and deerskin alone will be the criterion, not special conduct. Those signs will also cause people to be taken for one āśrama or another, and may govern the gestures of respect between wandering ascetics. Because of lack of livelihood and inability to give money, weakness in court will mean defeat. In scholarship, talkativeness will be taken for learning: speech will be mere fickleness.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
liṅgam evāśrama-khyātāv anyonyāpatti-kāraṇam |
avṛttyā nyāya-daurbalyaṃ pāṇḍitye cāpalaṃ vacaḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: असाधुत्वे चौर्याद्य्-अभियोगे । प्रसाधनम् अलङ्कारः ॥५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अनाढ्यतैवासाधुत्वे साधुत्वे दम्भ एव तु ।
स्वी-कार एव चोद्वाहे स्नानम् एव प्रसाधनम् ॥
word_for_word: in an accusation of theft and the like
entries.literal_english: In an accusation of theft and similar charges, poverty alone will be the proof of wickedness. Cleansing and bodily decoration will be treated as ornament.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
anāḍhyataivāsādhutve sādhutve dambha eva tu |
svī-kāra eva codvāhe snānam eva prasādhanam ||

entries.sanskrit: दूरे वर्तमानं वार्ययनं जलाशयस् तीर्थं, न तु गुर्व्-आदि । स्वार्थः पुरुषार्थः ॥६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
दूरे वार्य्-अयनं तीर्थं लावण्यं केश-धारणम् ।
उदरम्-भरता स्वार्थः सत्यत्वे धार्ष्ट्यम् एव हि ॥
word_for_word: a water reservoir is the sacred place
not a guru and the like
entries.literal_english: A water reservoir located far away will be considered a sacred place; not a guru or anything similar. Self-interest will be called the human goal.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
dūre vāry-ayanaṃ tīrthaṃ lāvaṇyaṃ keśa-dhāraṇam |
udaram-bharatā svārthaḥ satyatve dhārṣṭyam eva hi ||

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
दाक्ष्यं कुटुम्ब-भरणं यशोऽर्थे धर्म-सेवनम् ।
एवं प्रजाभिर् दुष्टाभिर् आकीर्णे क्षिति-मण्डले ॥

ब्रह्म-विट्-क्षत्र-शूद्राणां यो बली भविता नृपः ।
प्रजा हि लब्धै राजन्यैर् निर्घृणैर् दस्यु-धर्मभिः ॥
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. No separate Śrīdhara commentary is present in the pinned source.
entries.transliteration:
dākṣyaṃ kuṭumba-bharaṇaṃ yaśo’rthe dharma-sevanam |
evaṃ prajābhir duṣṭābhir ākīrṇe kṣiti-maṇḍale ||

brahma-viṭ-kṣatra-śūdrāṇāṃ yo balī bhavitā nṛpaḥ |
prajā hi labdhai rājanyair nirghṛṇair dasyu-dharmabhiḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: आच्छिन्ना अपहृता दारा द्रविणानि च यासां ताः । अष्टिर् बीजम् ॥९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
आच्छिन्न-दार-द्रविणा यास्यन्ति गिरि-काननम् ।
शाक-मूलामिष-क्षौद्र-फल-पुष्पाष्टि-भोजनाः ॥

अनावृष्ट्या विनङ्क्ष्यन्ति दुर्भिक्ष-कर-पीडिताः ।
शीत-वातातप-प्रावृड्-हिमैर् अन्योन्यतः प्रजाः ॥

क्षुत्-तृड्भ्यां व्याधिभिश् चैव सन्तप्स्यन्ते च चिन्तया ।
त्रिंशद् विंशति वर्षाणि परमायुः कलौ नृणाम् ॥
word_for_word: vegetables, roots, meat, honey, fruits and flowers
entries.literal_english: Those whose wives and wealth have been taken away will go to mountain forests and live on vegetables, roots, meat, honey, fruits, flowers, and ‘aṣṭi’ seed. Through drought they will perish, tormented by famine and oppressive taxation, and by cold, wind, heat, rain, and snow. They will be afflicted by hunger, thirst, disease, and anxiety. In Kali, the maximum human lifespan will be thirty plus twenty years.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
ācchinna-dāra-draviṇā yāsyanti giri-kānanam |
śāka-mūlāmiṣa-kṣaudra-phala-puṣpāṣṭi-bhojanāḥ ||

anāvṛṣṭyā vinaṅkṣyanti durbhikṣa-kara-pīḍitāḥ |
śīta-vātātapa-prāvṛḍ-himair anyonyataḥ prajāḥ ||

kṣut-tṛḍbhyāṃ vyādhibhiś caiva santapsyante ca cintayā |
triṃśad viṃśati varṣāṇi paramāyuḥ kalau nṛṇām ||

entries.sanskrit: क्षीयमाणेष्व् इत्य्-आदीनाम् इत्थं कलौ गत-प्राय इति पञ्चमेनान्वयः । क्षीयमाणेष्व् अल्प-प्रायेषु ॥१२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
क्षीयमाणेषु देहेषु देहिनां कलि-दोषतः ।
वर्णाश्रम-वतां धर्मे नष्टे वेद-पथे नृणाम् ॥
word_for_word: in the duties of those possessing varṇa and āśrama
entries.literal_english: Regarding the words beginning ‘when they are diminishing,’ the construction is with the earlier phrase ‘when Kali is nearly gone.’ ‘Diminishing’ means ‘when they have become very few.’ Thus the verse describes bodies wasting away because of Kali and the duties of people belonging to varṇa and āśrama being destroyed when the Vedic path is nearly extinct.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
kṣīyamāṇeṣu deheṣu dehināṃ kali-doṣataḥ |
varṇāśrama-vatāṃ dharme naṣṭe veda-pathe nṛṇām ||

entries.sanskrit: दस्यु-प्रायेषु चौर-तुल्येषु । चौर्यानृत-वृथाहिंसाद्या नाना-वृत्तयो येषां तेषु ।
entries.main_sanskrit:
पाषण्ड-प्रचुरे धर्मे दस्यु-प्रायेषु राजसु ।
चर्यानृत-वृथा-हिंसा- नाना-वृत्तिषु वै नृषु ॥
word_for_word: theft, falsehood, useless violence, and the like
entries.literal_english: ‘Mostly thieves’ means people equal to thieves. It refers to those whose various occupations consist of theft, falsehood, useless violence, and similar conduct.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
pāṣaṇḍa-pracure dharme dasyu-prāyeṣu rājasu |
caryānṛta-vṛthā-hiṃsā- nānā-vṛttiṣu vai nṛṣu ||

entries.sanskrit: छाग-प्रायासु प्रमाणतः क्षिरतश् चाजातुल्यासु ।
entries.main_sanskrit:
शूद्र-प्रायेषु वर्णेषु च्छाग-प्रायासु धेनुषु ।
गृह-प्रायेष्व् आश्रमेषु यौन-प्रायेषु बन्धुषु ॥
entries.literal_english: The women will be like she-goats in bodily measure and in milk-giving capacity; they will resemble goats.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
śūdra-prāyeṣu varṇeṣu cchāga-prāyāsu dhenuṣu |
gṛha-prāyeṣv āśrameṣu yauna-prāyeṣu bandhuṣu ||

entries.sanskrit: अणु-प्रायासु श्यामाक-तुल्यासु । स्थास्नुषु वृक्षेषु । विद्युत्-प्रायेषु तडिद्-बहुलेषु । शून्य-प्रायेषु धर्मादि-रहितेषु सद्मसु गृहेषु ॥१५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अणु-प्रायास्व् ओषधीषु शमी-प्रायेषु स्थास्नुषु ।
विद्युत्-प्रायेषु मेघेषु शून्य-प्रायेषु सद्मसु ॥
word_for_word: in houses devoid of dharma and the rest
entries.literal_english: Plants will be mostly tiny, like śyāmāka grain. Trees will stand, while lightning will be abundant. Houses will be almost empty, devoid of religious duty and the other signs of civilized life.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
aṇu-prāyāsv oṣadhīṣu śamī-prāyeṣu sthāsnuṣu |
vidyut-prāyeṣu megheṣu śūnya-prāyeṣu sadmasu ||

entries.sanskrit: जने तु खर-धर्मिणि दुःसह-चेष्टिते कलौ गत-प्राये समाप्त-प्राये ॥१६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
इत्थं कलौ गत-प्राये जनेषु खर-धर्मिषु ।
धर्म-त्राणाय सत्त्वेन भगवान् अवतरिष्यति ॥
word_for_word: possessing the nature of an ass
entries.literal_english: When Kali is nearly complete, the people will possess the nature of asses and their conduct will be unbearable.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
itthaṃ kalau gata-prāye janeṣu khara-dharmiṣu |
dharma-trāṇāya sattvena bhagavān avatariṣyati ||

entries.sanskrit: एतत् प्रपञ्चयति चतुर्भिः—चराचर-गुरोर् ईश्वरस्येति च । धर्म-त्राणे हेतुः, गुरुत्वेश्वरत्वयोर् उपपादनम् अखिलस्य विश्वस्यात्मनः कारणस्येति । एवं-भूतस्य विष्णोर् जन्म साधूनां धर्म-त्राणाय । धर्म-त्राण-प्रयोजनम् आह—कर्मापनुत्तये मोक्षाय ॥१७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
चराचर-गुरोर् विष्णोर् ईश्वरस्याखिलात्मनः ।
धर्म-त्राणाय साधूनां जन्म कर्मापनुत्तये ॥
word_for_word: he elaborates this in four verses
of the teacher of moving and nonmoving beings
the purpose is protection of dharma
the cause and Self of the entire universe
for protecting the dharma of the saintly
entries.literal_english: He elaborates this in four verses, beginning with ‘the Lord of moving and nonmoving beings.’ The incarnation is for protection of dharma; the verse establishes that he is the teacher and Lord, the cause and Self of the entire universe. The birth of such Viṣṇu is for protecting the dharma of the saintly. He states the purpose of that protection: removal of karma and attainment of liberation.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
carācara-guror viṣṇor īśvarasyākhilātmanaḥ |
dharma-trāṇāya sādhūnāṃ janma karmāpanuttaye ||

entries.sanskrit: शम्भल-ग्रामे मुख्यस्य प्रधानस्य नाम्ना विष्णुयशसो ब्राह्मणस्य । भवने गृहे ॥१८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
शम्भल-ग्राम-मुख्यस्य ब्राह्मणस्य महात्मनः ।
भवने विष्णुयशसः कल्किः प्रादुर्भविष्यति ॥
entries.literal_english: He will appear in the house of the brāhmaṇa Viṣṇuyaśas, the principal man of Śambhala village.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
śambhala-grāma-mukhyasya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
bhavane viṣṇuyaśasaḥ kalkiḥ prādurbhaviṣyati ||

entries.sanskrit:
धर्म-त्राण-प्रकारम् आह, अश्वम् इति । असाधवो दम्यन्ते येन तम् अश्वम् आरुह्यासिना दस्यून् कोटिशो निहनिष्यतीत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः । असाधु-दमन इति पाठे कल्कि-विशेषणम् । अणिमाद्य्-अष्टैश्वर्याणि गुणाश् च सत्य-सङ्कल्पत्वादयस् तैर् अन्वितः ॥१९॥

तत्-प्रपञ्चः, आशुना शीघ्र-गामिना तेन हयेनाश्वेन क्षोण्यां पृथिव्यां विचरन् । नृप-लिङ्ग-च्छदो राज-वेष-च्छन्नान् ॥२०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
अश्वम् आशु-गम् आरुह्य देवदत्तं जगत्-पतिः ।
असिनासाधु-दमनम् अष्टैश्वर्य-गुणान्वितः ॥

विचरन्न् आशुना क्षौण्यां हयेनाप्रतिम-द्युतिः ।
नृप-लिङ्ग-च्छदो दस्यून् कोटिशो निहनिष्यति ॥
word_for_word: he states the method of protecting dharma
by which the wicked are subdued
he will kill millions of thieves
the eight opulences beginning with aṇimā
entries.literal_english: He describes the method of protecting dharma: Kalki will mount the horse by which the wicked are subdued, and with a sword he will kill millions of thieves, as the following words are connected. In the reading ‘subduing the wicked,’ that phrase is an adjective of Kalki. He will be endowed with the eight opulences beginning with aṇimā and with qualities such as the power to make every resolve true.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
aśvam āśu-gam āruhya devadattaṃ jagat-patiḥ |
asināsādhu-damanam aṣṭaiśvarya-guṇānvitaḥ ||

vicarann āśunā kṣauṇyāṃ hayenāpratima-dyutiḥ |
nṛpa-liṅga-cchado dasyūn koṭiśo nihaniṣyati ||

entries.sanskrit: ततश् च पुनः कृत-युग-प्रवृत्तिं वक्तुम् आह, अथेति सार्धाभ्याम् । तेषां पौर-जानपदानां मनांसि विशदानि भविष्यन्ति । तत्र हेतुः, वासुदेवस्याङ्ग-रागेण चन्दनादिनाति-पुण्य-गन्धो योऽनिलस् तं स्पृशन्तीति तथा तेषाम् ।
entries.main_sanskrit:
अथ तेषां भविष्यन्ति मनांसि विशदानि वै ।
वासुदेवाङ्ग-रागाति- पुण्य-गन्धानिल-स्पृशाम् ॥

पौर-जानपदानां वै हतेष्व् अखिल-दस्युषु ॥
word_for_word: the rebeginning of the Kṛta age
by the sandal paste on Vāsudeva’s body
entries.literal_english: He then speaks of the rebeginning of the Kṛta age: the minds of those townspeople and rural people will become pure. The reason is that they will be touched by the wind carrying the exceedingly sacred fragrance of sandal paste and other unguents from Vāsudeva’s body.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
atha teṣāṃ bhaviṣyanti manāṃsi viśadāni vai |
vāsudevāṅga-rāgāti- puṇya-gandhānila-spṛśām ||

paura-jānapadānāṃ vai hateṣv akhila-dasyuṣu ||

entries.sanskrit: स्थविष्ठिः स्थूलः ॥२२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तेषां प्रजा-विसर्गश् च स्थविष्ठः सम्भविष्यति ।
वासुदेवे भगवति सत्त्व-मूर्तौ हृदि स्थिते ॥
entries.literal_english: ‘Sthaviṣṭhi’ means large or stout.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
teṣāṃ prajā-visargaś ca sthaviṣṭhaḥ sambhaviṣyati |
vāsudeve bhagavati sattva-mūrtau hṛdi sthite ||

entries.sanskrit: कृत-युग-प्रवृत्तिम् आह—यदावतीर्ण इति । प्रजानां सूतिः प्रसूतिः ॥२३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यदावतीर्णो भगवान् कल्किर् धर्म-पतिर् हरिः ।

कृतं भविष्यति तदा प्रजा-सूतिश् च सात्त्विकी ॥
word_for_word: he speaks of the beginning of the Kṛta age
entries.literal_english: He describes the beginning of the Kṛta age with ‘when he has descended.’ The word sūti means the generation or birth of the people.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source. The pinned source contains a footnote variant reading after the verse; the reader data keeps the verse text itself and records the commentary block separately.
entries.transliteration:
yadāvatīrṇo bhagavān kalkir dharma-patir hariḥ |

kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati tadā prajā-sūtiś ca sāttvikī ||

entries.sanskrit: तद्-अवतार-कालोपलक्षणम् आह—यदा चन्द्रश् चेति । तिष्यः पुष्यः । अयम् अर्थः, चन्द्र-सूर्य-बृहस्पतीनां यदा पुष्य-नक्षत्रे योगस् तदा तत् कृत-युगं भविष्यति । यद्य् अपि च प्रति-द्वादशाब्दं कर्क-राशौ बृहस्पतौ वर्तमाने द्वि-त्रास्व् अमावास्यासु तेषां त्रयाणाम् अपि पुष्य-योगः संभवति, तथापि तेषां सह प्रवेशोऽत्र विवक्षितः । समेष्यन्तीति वचनात् । अतो नातिप्रसङ्गः ॥२४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यदा चन्द्रश् च सूर्यश् च तथा तिष्य-बृहस्पती ।
एक-राशौ समेष्यन्ति भविष्यति तदा कृतम् ॥
word_for_word: a marker of the time of the incarnation
the conjunction of Moon, Sun and Jupiter
entries.literal_english: He marks the time of that incarnation: Tiṣya means Puṣya. The meaning is that when the Moon, Sun and Jupiter come together in the Puṣya constellation, that will be the Kṛta age. Although their conjunction in Puṣya can occur every twelve years while Jupiter is in Cancer, with two or three new moons, the verse intends their simultaneous entry together, as shown by the word ‘will come together’; thus there is no unwanted extension of the prediction.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
yadā candraś ca sūryaś ca tathā tiṣya-bṛhaspatī |
eka-rāśau sameṣyanti bhaviṣyati tadā kṛtam ||

entries.sanskrit: एवं नवम-स्कन्धम् आरभ्यानुक्रान्तं वैवस्वत-मनोर् वंश-द्वयं निगमयति—येऽतीता इति । उद्देशतः सङ्क्षेपतः ॥२५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
येऽतीता वर्तमाना ये भविष्यन्ति च पार्थिवाः ।
ते त उद्देशतः प्रोक्ता वंशीयाः सोम-सूर्ययोः ॥
word_for_word: the two dynasties of Vaivasvata Manu
entries.literal_english: Beginning with the Ninth Canto, he concludes the two dynasties of Vaivasvata Manu that have been narrated, presenting them briefly and in summary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
ye’tītā vartamānā ye bhaviṣyanti ca pārthivāḥ |
te ta uddeśataḥ proktā vaṃśīyāḥ soma-sūryayoḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: कलि-युगावान्तर-विशेषं वक्तुम् आह—आरभ्येत्य्-आदिना । वर्ष-सहस्रं पञ्चदशोत्तरं शतं चेति कयापि विवक्षयावान्तर-सङ्ख्येयम् । वस्तुतस् तु परीक्षिन्-नन्दयोर् अन्तरं द्वाभ्यां न्यूनं वर्षाणां सार्ध-सहस्रं भवति । यतः परीक्षित्-सम-कालं मागधं मार्जारिम् आरभ्य रिपुञ्जयान्ता विंशति-राजानः सहस्र-संवत्सरं भोक्ष्यन्तीत्य् उक्तं नवम-स्कन्धे, ये बार्हद्रथ-भू-पाला भाव्याः साहस्र-वत्सरं [भा।पु। ९.२२.४९] इति । ततः परं पञ्च प्रद्योतना अष्ट-त्रिंशोत्तरं शतम् । शिशुनागाश् च षष्ट्य्-उत्तर-शत-त्रयं भोक्ष्यन्ति पृथिवीम् इत्य् अत्रैवोक्तत्वात् ॥२६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
आरभ्य भवतो जन्म यावन् नन्दाभिषेचनम् ।
एतद् वर्ष-सहस्रं तु शतं पञ्चदशोत्तरम् ॥
word_for_word: a particular intermediate period of Kali-yuga
the interval between Parīkṣit and Nanda
entries.literal_english: He now states a particular intermediate period of Kali, beginning with the words ‘starting from.’ The figure of one thousand one hundred and fifteen years is meant as a count of an intermediate period. In fact, the interval between Parīkṣit and Nanda is one thousand five hundred years less two. For it is said in the Ninth Canto that, beginning with the contemporary Magadha king Mārgāri and ending with Ripuñjaya, twenty kings will rule for a thousand years; after them the five Pradyotanas will rule for one hundred and thirty-eight years, and the Śiśunāgas will rule the earth for three hundred and sixty years, as stated here.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
ārabhya bhavato janma yāvan nandābhiṣecanam |
etad varṣa-sahasraṃ tu śataṃ pañcadaśottaram ||

entries.sanskrit: कलेः प्रवृत्तिं वृद्धिं च निरूपयितुं काल-ज्ञानोपलक्षणम् आह—सप्तर्षीणां त्व् इति । अयम् अर्थः—प्राग् अग्र-शकटाकारं तारा-सप्तकं सप्तर्षि-मण्डलम् । तत्र किञ्चिद् उन्नतेषाग्र-स्थानीयो मरीचिः । ततः पश्चाद् आनम्र-युग-कन्धराकारो वसिष्ठः स-भार्यः । ततः पश्चाद् ईषद्-उन्नतेषामूल-स्थानीयोऽङ्गिराः । ततः पश्चाच् चतुरस्र-तारा-चतुष्के ईशान्याम् अत्रिः । ततो दक्षिणतः पुलस्त्यः । पुलस्त्यात् पश्चिमतः पुलहः । तत उत्तरतः क्रतुः । एवं स्थिते, तेषां मध्ये यौ पूर्वौ उदय-समये प्रथमम् उदितौ दृश्येते पुलह-क्रतु-संज्ञौ, तयोस् तु मध्ये तयोः पूर्वयोस् तु मध्ये यत् समं दक्षिणोत्तर-रेखायां सम-देशावस्थितम् अश्विन्य्-आदिषु यद् अन्यतमं नक्षत्रं दृश्यते, तेन तथैव युक्ता ऋषयः नृणाम् अब्द-शतं तिष्ठन्ति, ते च द्विजास् त्वदीये कालेऽधुना मघा आश्रिता वर्तन्ते ॥२७-२८॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
सप्तर्षीणां तु यौ पूर्वौ दृश्येते उदितौ दिवि ।
तयोस् तु मध्ये नक्षत्रं दृश्यते यत् समं निशि ॥

तेनैव ऋषयो युक्तास् तिष्ठन्त्य् अब्द-शतं नृणाम् ।
ते त्वदीये द्विजाः काल अधुना चाश्रिता मघाः ॥
word_for_word: the beginning and growth of Kali
entries.literal_english: To describe the beginning and growth of Kali, he gives a sign for reckoning time through the Seven Sages. The seven stars form the shape of a cart: Marīci is at the slightly raised front; behind him is Vasiṣṭha, shaped like the bent neck of a yoke, together with his wife; behind him is Aṅgirā; then Atri is in the northeastern corner of a square of four stars; to the south is Pulastya, to the west of him Pulaha, and to the north of that Kratu. Of the two eastern stars first seen at rising, Pulaha and Kratu, the constellation lying between them on the north-south line is the relevant one. The Sages remain joined with each successive constellation for one hundred human years, and in the present time they are situated in Maghā.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
saptarṣīṇāṃ tu yau pūrvau dṛśyete uditau divi |
tayos tu madhye nakṣatraṃ dṛśyate yat samaṃ niśi ||

tenaiva ṛṣayo yuktās tiṣṭhanty abda-śataṃ nṛṇām |
te tvadīye dvijāḥ kāla adhunā cāśritā maghāḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: तेषु मघसु वर्तमानेषु सत्सु यदा विष्णोर् भानुर् भातीति भानुः शुद्ध-सत्त्वात्मको देहो दिवं वैकुण्ठं गतः, तदा कलि-युगम् अविशत् । यद् यस्मिन् युगे जनः पापे रमते इति कलि-युगस्य लक्षणम् ॥२९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
विष्णोर् भगवतो भानुः कृष्णाख्योऽसौ दिवं गतः ।
तदाविशत् कलिर् लोकं पापे यद् रमते जनः ॥
word_for_word: a body consisting of pure goodness
entries.literal_english: When the stars are situated in Maghā, the radiance of Viṣṇu—whose ‘sun’ is a body made of pure spiritual goodness—has gone to heaven, Vaikuṇṭha; at that time Kali-yuga entered. The characteristic of Kali-yuga is that people delight in sin.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
viṣṇor bhagavato bhānuḥ kṛṣṇākhyo’sau divaṃ gataḥ |
tadāviśat kalir lokaṃ pāpe yad ramate janaḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: ननु श्री-कृष्णे पृथिव्यां वर्तमानेऽपि सन्ध्या-रूपेण कलिः प्रविष्ट एवासीत्, सत्यम्, तथापि तावत् तस्य पराक्रमो नाभवद् इत्य् आह—यावद् इति । पराक्रान्तुम् अभिभवितुम् ॥३०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यावत् स पाद-पद्माभ्यां स्पृशन् आस्ते रमा-पतिः ।
तावत् कलिर् वै पृथिवीं पराक्रन्तुं न चाशकत् ॥
word_for_word: while Śrī Kṛṣṇa was present on earth
in the form of the twilight period
entries.literal_english: One may object that, even while Śrī Kṛṣṇa was present on earth, Kali had already entered in the form of a twilight period. That is true; nevertheless, Kali did not yet have the power to overcome the world. He says ‘until’ to indicate the time before Kali could prevail. The source adds a cross-reference to the corresponding verse at ŚB 1.18.6.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source. The pinned source contains a cross-reference footnote to ŚB 1.18.6; the commentary translation records that cross-reference.
entries.transliteration:
yāvat sa pāda-padmābhyāṃ spṛśan āste ramā-patiḥ |
tāvat kalir vai pṛthivīṃ parākrantuṃ na cāśakat ||

entries.sanskrit: अतो यथोक्त एव कलि-प्रवेश-काल इत्य् आह—यदा देवर्षय इति । द्वादशाब्द-शतात्मक इति । दिव्येन मानेन सन्ध्या-सन्ध्यांशाभ्यां सह यो द्वादशाब्द-शतात्मकः, स कलिस् तदा सन्ध्याम् अतिक्रम्य प्रविष्ट इत्य् अर्थः ॥३१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यदा देवर्षयः सप्त मघासु विचरन्ति हि ।
तदा प्रवृत्तस् तु कलिर् द्वादशाब्द-शतात्मकः ॥
word_for_word: together with dawn and twilight portions
entries.literal_english: Therefore he states that the time of Kali’s entry is exactly as described: when the divine sages are in Maghā. Kali, consisting of twelve hundred years by divine reckoning together with its dawn and twilight portions, entered after crossing the twilight portion.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
yadā devarṣayaḥ sapta maghāsu vicaranti hi |
tadā pravṛttas tu kalir dvādaśābda-śatātmakaḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: कलेः प्रवेश-कालम् उक्त्वा तस्य वृद्धि-कालम् आह—यदेति । तदा प्रद्योतनात् प्रभृति वृद्धिं गच्छन् नन्दात् प्रभृत्य् अतिवृद्धिं गमिष्यतीत्य् अर्थः ॥३२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यदा मघाभ्यो यास्यन्ति पूर्वाषाठां महर्षयः ।
तदा नन्दात् प्रभृत्य् एष कलिर् वृद्धिं गमिष्यति ॥
entries.literal_english: Having stated the time of Kali’s entry, he now states the period of its growth. From the Pradyotas onward it will increase, and beginning with Nanda it will increase greatly.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
yadā maghābhyo yāsyanti pūrvāṣāṭhāṃ maharṣayaḥ |
tadā nandāt prabhṛty eṣa kalir vṛddhiṃ gamiṣyati ||

entries.sanskrit: ननु यदा कलेर् लिङ्गम् उपलब्धं, तदैव प्रविष्ट इति युक्तम् । ततः पूर्वम् एव प्रवेशस् ततः परं वृद्धिर् इत्य् अत्र किं प्रमाणम् ? तत्राह—यस्मिन्न् इति । प्रतिपन्नं प्रविष्टम् इति ज्ञातम् । पुरा-विदः पूर्व-ज्ञातारः ॥३३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
यस्मिन् कृष्णो दिवं यातस् तस्मिन्न् एव तदाहनि ।
प्रतिपन्नं कलि-युगम् इति प्राहुः पुरा-विदः ॥
word_for_word: it is known that it has entered
entries.literal_english: One might object: when the sign of Kali became perceptible, it would be reasonable to say that Kali entered then. What proof is there that its entry occurred earlier and its growth later? He answers: when the sign became established, it was known that Kali had entered; the ancient historians know the earlier distinction between entry and subsequent growth.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
yasmin kṛṣṇo divaṃ yātas tasminn eva tadāhani |
pratipannaṃ kali-yugam iti prāhuḥ purā-vidaḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: कलेर् अनन्तरं कृत-युग-प्रवेशम् आह—दिव्याब्दानाम् इति । चतुर्थे कलौ प्रवेशनाब्द-परिमितेनांशेनापि सहातीते सतीत्य् अर्थः । कृत-युग-प्रवेश-चिह्नम् आह—यदा नॄणां मन आत्म-प्रकाशकं भविष्यति तदेति ॥३४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्रान्ते चतुर्थे तु पुनः कृतम् ।
भविष्यति तदा नॄणां मन आत्म-प्रकाशकम् ॥
word_for_word: the entry of the Kṛta age
entries.literal_english: He speaks of the entry of the Kṛta age after Kali. When even the portion of the fourth age measured by its divine years has passed, the Kṛta age will begin. Its sign is that people’s minds will become self-luminous.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
divyābdānāṃ sahasrānte caturthe tu punaḥ kṛtam |
bhaviṣyati tadā nṝṇāṃ mana ātma-prakāśakam ||

entries.sanskrit: राज-वंशोक्तां स्थितिं ब्राह्मणादि-वंशेष्व् अप्य् अतिदिशति—इत्य् एष इति । यथा याभिर् उच्च-नीचावस्थाभिः । तास् ता अवस्थाः । वंशा इति वा पाठः ॥३५॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
इत्य् एष मानवो वंशो यथा सङ्ख्यायते भुवि ।
तथा विट्-शूद्र-विप्राणां तास् ता ज्ञेया युगे युगे ॥
word_for_word: the condition stated for royal dynasties
in the dynasties beginning with brāhmaṇas
by the high and low conditions
entries.literal_english: He extends the condition stated for the royal dynasties to the dynasties beginning with brāhmaṇas and the others. The high and low conditions are the respective states described; alternatively, the reading may be ‘dynasties.’
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
ity eṣa mānavo vaṃśo yathā saṅkhyāyate bhuvi |
tathā viṭ-śūdra-viprāṇāṃ tās tā jñeyā yuge yuge ||

entries.sanskrit: एतत्-कीर्तनस्य वैराग्योपयोगिताम् आह—एतेषाम् इति । नामैव लिङ्गं ज्ञापकं येषां, तेषां कथा-मात्रेणैवावशिष्टानां कीर्तिर् एव स्थिता, न तु राज्यं पुत्रादयो वा ॥३६॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
एतेषां नाम-लिङ्गानां पुरुषाणां महात्मनाम् ।
कथा-मात्रावशिष्टानां कीर्तिर् एव स्थिता भुवि ॥
word_for_word: the name alone is the sign
of those for whom it is the indicator
not kingdom, sons, and so on
entries.literal_english: He states how this recitation is useful for developing detachment. For those whose only surviving sign is their name, after they have disappeared, only the fame contained in the story remains; their kingdom, sons, and other possessions do not remain.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
eteṣāṃ nāma-liṅgānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ mahātmanām |
kathā-mātrāvaśiṣṭānāṃ kīrtir eva sthitā bhuvi ||

entries.sanskrit: कलाव् उत्सन्नानां राज-वंशानां पुनः प्रवृत्ति-प्रकारम् आह—देवापिः सोम-वंश-जः । मरुस् तु सूर्य-वंश-जः । कलाप-ग्रामो नाम योगिनाम् आवासः प्रसिद्धः ॥३७॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
देवापिः शान्तनोर् भ्राता मरुश् चेक्ष्वाकु-वंश-जः ।
कलाप-ग्राम आसाते महा-योग-बलान्वितौ ॥
word_for_word: Devāpi, born in the lunar dynasty
Maru, born in the solar dynasty
entries.literal_english: He describes how the royal dynasties destroyed in Kali will arise again. Devāpi is born in the lunar dynasty, while Maru is born in the solar dynasty. Kalāpa is known as a village that is the residence of yogīs.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
devāpiḥ śāntanor bhrātā maruś cekṣvāku-vaṃśa-jaḥ |
kalāpa-grāma āsāte mahā-yoga-balānvitau ||

entries.sanskrit: न व्याख्यातम्।
entries.main_sanskrit:
ताव् इहैत्य कलेर् अन्ते वासुदेवानुशिक्षितौ ।
वर्णाश्रम-युतं धर्मं पूर्व-वत् प्रथयिष्यतः ॥
entries.literal_english: No commentary.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. No separate Śrīdhara commentary is present in the pinned source.
entries.transliteration:
tāv ihaitya kaler ante vāsudevānuśikṣitau |
varṇāśrama-yutaṃ dharmaṃ pūrva-vat prathayiṣyataḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: इमम् एव प्रकारं प्रति चतुर्-युगं दर्शयति—कृतम् इति ॥३९॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश् चेति चतुर्-युगम् ।
अनेन क्रम-योगेन भुवि प्राणिषु वर्तते ॥
word_for_word: in each cycle of four ages
entries.literal_english: He shows that this same process occurs in every cycle of four ages: Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali. In this sequential order, the four-age cycle continues among living beings on earth.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliś ceti catur-yugam |
anena krama-yogena bhuvi prāṇiṣu vartate ||

entries.sanskrit: एतेषां नाम-लिङ्गानां [भा।पु। १२.२.३६] इत्य्-आदि यद् उक्तं तत् प्रपञ्चयति—राजन्न् इति पञ्चभिः ॥४०॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
राजन्न् एते मया प्रोक्ता नर-देवास् तथापरे ।
भूमौ ममत्वं कृत्वान्ते हित्वेमां निधनं गताः ॥
word_for_word: these have been spoken by me
having developed possessiveness over the earth
entries.literal_english: O King, these and the other kings who are rulers among men have been described by me. Having developed possessiveness toward the earth, they eventually left it and went to death.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
rājann ete mayā proktā nara-devās tathāpare |
bhūmau mamatvaṃ kṛtvānte hitvemāṃ nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: ममत्वं कृत्वेत्य् अनेन सूचितां भूत-द्रोह-प्रवृत्तिं निन्दति—कृमीति । राज-नाम्नो राजेति नाम यस्य तस्यापि देहस्यान्ते कृमयो विष्ठा भस्मेति वा संज्ञा भविष्यति । तत्-कृते तद्-अर्थं यो भूत-ध्रुक् भूतेभ्यो द्रुह्यति, स किं स्वार्थं वेद ? किं तु न वेदैव । कुतः ? इत्य् अपेक्षायां हेतुत्वेन भूत-द्रोहं विशिनष्टि, यतो भूत-द्रोहान् निरयो भवति ॥४१॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कृमि-विड्-भस्म-संज्ञान्ते राज-नाम्नोऽपि यस्य च ।
भूत-ध्रुक् तत्-कृते स्वार्थं किं वेद निरयो यतः ॥
word_for_word: at the end, known as worms, stool and ashes
even of one bearing the name king
what does he know of his own welfare?
entries.literal_english: He condemns the violence toward beings implied by possessiveness. At the end, even the body of one called a king is designated as worms, stool, or ashes. What can a person who harms living beings for the sake of that body know about his own true welfare? He does not know it, because the result is hell.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
kṛmi-viḍ-bhasma-saṃjñānte rāja-nāmno’pi yasya ca |
bhūta-dhruk tat-kṛte svārthaṃ kiṃ veda nirayo yataḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: ममत्व-प्रकारं प्रपञ्चयति—कथम् इति । सेयम् अखण्डा भूर् मे पूर्व-जैर् धृता सती इदानीं मत्-पूर्वा च सती मत्-पुत्रादेः कथं स्याद् इत्य् एवम् ॥४२॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
कथं सेयम् अखण्डा भूः पूर्वैर् मे पुरुषैर् धृता ।
मत्-पुत्रस्य च पौत्रस्य मत्-पूर्वा वंश-जस्य वा ॥
word_for_word: or to one born in my dynasty
entries.literal_english: He elaborates the possessiveness: ‘How can this undivided earth, once held by my forefathers, now belong to me, when it was held by my predecessors and will belong to my son, grandson, or another born in my dynasty?’
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
kathaṃ seyam akhaṇḍā bhūḥ pūrvair me puruṣair dhṛtā |
mat-putrasya ca pautrasya mat-pūrvā vaṃśa-jasya vā ||

entries.sanskrit: उभौ महीं कायं च । अदर्शनं मृत्युम् ॥४३॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
तेजो-ऽब्-अन्न-मयं कायं गृहीत्वात्मतयाबुधाः ।
महीं ममतया चोभौ हित्वान्तेऽदर्शनं गताः ॥
word_for_word: the body made of fire, water and food
the ignorant, taking it as the self
entries.literal_english: ‘Both’ means the earth and the body. The ignorant, taking the body made of fire, water, and food to be the self and claiming the earth as ‘mine,’ abandoned both at the end and went to death.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
tejo-’b-anna-mayaṃ kāyaṃ gṛhītvātmatayābudhāḥ |
mahīṃ mamatayā cobhau hitvānte’darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||

entries.sanskrit: उपसंहरति—ये ये इति । ते सर्वे च कथासु क्रियमाणासु । कथा-मात्राः कालेन कृताः ॥४४॥
entries.main_sanskrit:
ये ये भू-पतयो राजन् भुञ्जते भुवम् ओजसा ।
कालेन ते कृताः सर्वे कथा-मात्राः कथासु च ॥
entries.literal_english: He concludes: all the kings who have ruled the earth with their power are, in the course of time, made into mere stories in the narratives about them.
entries.source_note: Pinned source: vishvAsa/purANam_vaiShNavam @ 100560de6c9f68c2875097d40a2012a84c784179; exact source range preserved. Śrīdhara commentary translated from the pinned Devanāgarī source.
entries.transliteration:
ye ye bhū-patayo rājan bhuñjate bhuvam ojasā |
kālena te kṛtāḥ sarve kathā-mātrāḥ kathāsu ca ||
